null_policy: A null reference field matches only a null predicted field. A missing mixture contributes 11 incorrect core fields.
identifier_policy: Rows are matched within each paper by source mixture identifier after trimming surrounding whitespace.
categorical_policy: Categorical and identifier fields require exact normalized equality; null is distinct from an empty string.
numeric_policy: Numeric values match when the absolute difference after unit normalization is no greater than 0.011.
